## v0.4.1-5 Release Notes

### ✨ Feature

- Added avatars to direct-message headers and message bubbles, including pending messages.

### ⚡ Optimization

- Refresh contact profiles when opening a chat, returning to the page, and every 30 seconds while visible, without reloading message history or resetting the scroll position.
- Preserve loaded user-directory pages during refresh.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Fixed uploaded and generated avatars failing to display in direct-message lists.
- Fixed open chats retaining outdated contact profiles, including contacts outside the loaded list pages.

---

## v0.4.1-5 中文版本

### ✨ Feature

- 私聊窗口顶部和双方消息旁新增头像显示，发送中的消息也显示头像。

### ⚡ Optimization

- 打开会话、重新聚焦页面及页面可见时每 30 秒刷新联系人资料，更新头像时保留历史消息和滚动位置。
- 用户目录刷新时保留已加载的分页。

### 🐛 Fixed

- 修复私聊列表中上传头像和随机头像无法正常显示的问题。
- 修复已打开的会话保留旧联系人资料的问题，联系人不在已加载列表页中时也能更新。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/amaoworks/DEEIX-Chat/compare/v0.4.1-4...v0.4.1-5
